ModMetaData.name: Faction Gear Seeder (Community)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Data-driven opening faction GEAR. Author a FactionGearSeedDef in XML — for a given FactionDef, list per-PawnKind forced apparel, weapons, and quality — and the mod applies it to every pawn that faction generates (raiders, caravans, settlers, guards), so a themed faction actually LOOKS and FIGHTS the way you designed.

This is the gear layer of the opening-world pipeline, sibling to Faction Relation Seeder (pas.relations.community): Worldbuilder sets the roster, the relation seeder sets who is friend or foe, and this sets what everyone wears and wields.

Workflow: prototype a faction's loadout in-game with yc's Faction Editor (or any editor), export the preset, transcribe it into a FactionGearSeedDef with the bundled tool, and ship it — players do NOT need yc installed, only this small engine.

Uses Harmony (a single PawnGenerator.GeneratePawn postfix) — the only way to reproduce forced loadouts as redistributable data. Factions and items referenced by defName are resolved softly at runtime — anything not present is skipped, never an error.
